name: SeisMonitor
notes: Earthquake alerts rebuilt as 3-D terrain — the shockwave ripples across the quake's real landscape, epicentre on its true coordinates
24-hour high now cycles through every quake within 20% of the day's strongest, not just the single biggest
WiFi setup: pick your network from a live scanned list, and it reconnects on its own if the connection drops
NZ severity colour driven by GeoNet's real felt-intensity (MMI), not just magnitude and depth
Smarter place-name text layout — no more mid-word line breaks
